clue.text: People singing about god

parts.note: C is short for circa, Latin for about
Horus is the falcon-headed Egyptian sky god

explanation.surface: A choir lifts its voice in praise of a deity.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of singers performing together is a synonym for a choir.

clue.text: Large building made of wood on a hillside, say

indicators.note: say tells us the word is only to be heard, not written as spoken

parts.note: a hanger is a wood growing on a steep hillside, a southern English term

explanation.surface: A timber barn stands on a slope.
explanation.walkthrough: 'made of' is a link; HANGER, the regional name for a hillside wood, is pronounced just like the aircraft shed.
explanation.definitionFit: An aircraft shed is a very large building, the standard sense of the word.

clue.text: Waves overwhelming girl's wheeled transport

indicators.note: in a down entry, one piece overwhelming another sits above it, so it comes first

parts.note: rollers are long heavy sea waves
Kate is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A girl is knocked over by big waves while out on her wheels.
explanation.definitionFit: Footwear fitted with small wheels is a form of personal wheeled transport.

clue.text: Way to signal heroes are wounded capturing plan

indicators.note: capturing means the scrambled letters hold the next piece inside them
wounded heroes are hurt and knocked out of shape, so their letters are rearranged

parts.note: a map is a plan of an area

explanation.surface: Injured soldiers grab the battle plan and work out how to send a message.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wounded' reads as injured soldiers, but 'are wounded' means the hero letters are rearranged, and 'capturing' wraps that anagram round the plan.
explanation.definitionFit: Flag signalling with the arms is a recognised way of sending messages over distance.

clue.text: Sporting event with reptile run down

parts.note: a boa is a large constricting snake
to run down someone is to trace or track them

explanation.surface: A snake is hunted down at a sports fixture.
explanation.walkthrough: THE BOAT RACE is the annual Oxford v Cambridge rowing contest on the Thames.
explanation.definitionFit: The annual university rowing contest is a famous British sporting event.

clue.text: Found judge visiting Northern Ireland a dog

parts.note: to found something is to base or establish it

indicators.note: a visitor goes inside a place, so one piece is placed within the other

explanation.surface: A judge on a trip to Northern Ireland discovers a dog.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Found' looks like the past of find, but it is the verb meaning establish.
explanation.definitionFit: The barkless hunting hound from central Africa is a breed of dog.

clue.text: Nothing taken by fisherman losing lead

indicators.note: losing its lead means the first letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: a fish taken by an angler has been caught

explanation.surface: An angler's catch slips off before he lands it, leaving him empty-handed.
explanation.definitionFit: An archaic word for zero, nought or nothing at all.

clue.text: Eerie spirit

definitions.meaning: an old British slang adjective meaning odd or strange
a liquor distilled from sugar cane

explanation.definitionFit: Both a dated word for strange and the sugar-cane liquor drunk by sailors.

clue.text: Note perfect finish in handicraft

indicators.note: in places the final letter within the craft word

parts.note: crochet is a handicraft of looping yarn with a hook

indicators.note: a word's finish is its last letter

explanation.surface: A craftsman adds the perfect finishing touch to his needlework.
explanation.definitionFit: In music a quarter note, worth one beat, is a type of note.

clue.text: Fans alight

definitions.meaning: fans as a verb means stirs up or makes burn more fiercely

explanation.definitionFit: Both the verb for stoking a fire or passion and the two-word phrase for burning.

clue.text: Bound to have a flutter, by the sound of it

indicators.note: by the sound of it says only the pronunciation of the word is wanted

parts.note: a flutter is a small bet, so to have one is to gamble

explanation.surface: Someone is sure to place a small bet, apparently.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Bound' looks like 'certain to', but it is the definition: to leap.
explanation.definitionFit: To skip or frolic playfully is to leap about, a synonym of bound.

clue.text: Slap, and bury the hatchet

definitions.meaning: slap is British theatre slang for cosmetics
to end a quarrel and become friends again

explanation.definitionFit: Slang for cosmetics, and a phrasal verb meaning reconcile after a quarrel.

clue.text: Songbird in roof, snug in the middle at first

indicators.note: at first puts the picked letters at the front of the charade
in the middle picks the central letters of the word that precedes it

parts.note: thatch is a roof of straw or reeds

explanation.surface: A bird nestles cosily in the roof space.
explanation.definitionFit: A small tree-climbing bird that cracks nuts is a type of songbird.

clue.text: Compare this somehow with a pervasive mood

indicators.note: somehow means the letters are put together in some new way

explanation.surface: A reviewer weighs up a piece with a strong mood.
explanation.definitionFit: A piece rich in mood or feeling is described as evocative in this way.

clue.text: Unseasonable weather for this plant

definitions.meaning: the read-literally phrase for a freak June blizzard
a low grey-leaved alpine of the genus Cerastium with white flowers

explanation.definitionFit: Literally a freak blizzard in warm months, and the common name of a white-flowered garden alpine.

clue.text: Sentimental boy accepts pound for baggy garment

indicators.note: accepts means the two words take in the next piece

parts.note: soppy means mawkishly sentimental
L is the abbreviation for pound, from Latin libra
Joe is a boy's name

explanation.surface: A soft-hearted lad pockets a pound to buy a loose top.
explanation.definitionFit: A loose, oversized sweater is a kind of baggy garment.

clue.text: Midnight, when operation is due to start

definitions.meaning: on the twenty-four hour clock, midnight is written 0000

definitions.text: when operation is due to start
definitions.meaning: the scheduled moment a military operation begins

explanation.definitionFit: Midnight is 0000 hours, and the phrase also names the planned start of an attack.

clue.text: Team organise irregular living arrangements

definitions.note: the definition is plural while the answer names one such household

indicators.note: irregular means the letters are set out in no regular order

explanation.surface: A team is told to sort out some unusual housing.
explanation.walkthrough: 'organise' looks like the anagram signal, but it is fodder; 'irregular' does that job and also colours the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A household of three lovers is an unconventional domestic arrangement.

clue.text: Warm reception initially accorded to production of Hamlet

indicators.note: a production of a play reworks it, so the letters are reshaped
initially picks the first letter of the word

explanation.surface: A new staging of Shakespeare's tragedy gets an enthusiastic welcome.
explanation.walkthrough: 'accorded to' is a link; the R from 'reception initially' joins HAMLET in the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Clothing that retains body heat is described as warm.

clue.text: Blinds erode installed in ship

indicators.note: installed in means one piece is set within the other

parts.note: SS is the abbreviation for steamship
to wear is to erode or abrade gradually

explanation.surface: Window shades fade after being fitted on board a vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Blinds' is not window shades but the verb from 'effing and blinding': cursing.
explanation.definitionFit: To blind is British slang for curse, as in effing and blinding.

clue.text: In the fashion of North Africans, about to enter place of worship

definitions.text: In the fashion of North Africans

indicators.note: to enter means one piece goes inside the other

parts.note: a mosque is a Muslim place of worship
re means about or concerning

explanation.surface: North Africans arrive at their house of prayer.
explanation.definitionFit: Done in the Moorish manner, the Moors being North African peoples.

clue.text: Leave nothing inside the ring

indicators.note: inside places one piece within the other

parts.note: to quit is to leave
O is zero, nothing

explanation.surface: A boxer walks out of the ring with nothing to show.
explanation.definitionFit: A ring of rope or metal thrown at a peg in the game of quoits.

clue.text: Expressions of disapproval from playwright covered by afterthought

indicators.note: covered by means the first piece is wrapped by the second

parts.note: PS, postscript, is an afterthought at the end of a letter
George Bernard Shaw was an Irish playwright

explanation.surface: A writer's letter ends with a postscript complaining.
explanation.definitionFit: Exclamations of contempt or impatience are expressions of disapproval.

clue.text: Robin loves a jinx

parts.note: Robin Hood, the outlaw of English legend
love is zero in tennis, and O looks like zero, so loves give OO

explanation.surface: A lad named Robin adores a curse.
explanation.definitionFit: Something that brings bad luck is a jinx.

clue.text: Kick the bucket, one proverbially straight

definitions.meaning: a slang idiom meaning to pass away
the saying 'straight as a ...' means honest

explanation.definitionFit: To pass away, and the cube used in board games, named in the saying for honesty.

clue.text: Main preserve for islander

parts.note: major means main or principal
to can is to preserve food in tins

explanation.surface: The chief aim is to conserve an island community.
explanation.definitionFit: A native of a large Balearic island in the Mediterranean is an islander.

clue.text: Relation relocated in the east

indicators.note: relocated means moved, so the letters are moved into a new order

explanation.surface: A relative has moved to Asia.
explanation.definitionFit: The adjective means eastern, of or situated in the Far East.

clue.text: Tax cut

definitions.meaning: a duty levied on goods produced at home
to cut out or remove surgically

explanation.definitionFit: A duty charged on home-produced goods, and a verb for removing by cutting.
